excerpts.content:
Had a quick meeting today — thank you team Ipsilon and everyone who joined in!

**Summary & Next Steps:**
- Pooja will wait for a signal before restoring the EVMMAX & EOF meetings to the Protocol Calendar. (Both are currently removed.)
- EOF status update and potential champion expected early next week.
- EEST will preserve the EOF testing work for future upgrade considerations.
- Ipsilon team will consider to bring the team's paper on RICSV and EOF into the next ACD meeting’s agenda to increase visibility.

Thank you all for your contribution 🙏
